film.noSchedule: No showtimes in {{city}} on this date yet.
film.comingSoon: This film opens on {{date}}. Showtimes open closer to release.

seat.hint: Tap any open seat to see the screen from that spot before you book.
seat.name: Row {{row}}, Seat {{num}}

desc.upClose: The screen spills past the edges of your vision and you'll look about {{tilt}}° up. Maximum spectacle, some neck work.
desc.side: You're {{off}}° off-center, so the picture looks noticeably skewed. Fine for a rewatch, less so for a premiere.
desc.immersive: The screen fills almost all of your view. Great for action, a little close for reading subtitles.
desc.sweet: The best balance here: the screen fills your view without moving your head, and the sound is mixed for this spot.
desc.great: Big, comfortable picture with only a slight angle. A solid pick if the center is gone.
desc.full: You take in the whole frame at a glance with a relaxed, level sightline.
desc.fullRec: You take in the whole frame at a glance with a relaxed, level sightline, and you get to put your feet up.

seat.taken: Seat {{seats}} was just taken by someone else. Please pick another.
